dataMappings: Japanese tokens, UTF-16 spans, candidate terms, and term-variant suggestions are derived from the pinned SnapshotReader; dictionary and ignore changes are ChangeOperation proposals.

proofs.result: The public nlp.analyze and nlp.discoverCandidates actions run the real Lindera worker, preserve Japanese token/sentence offsets including an emoji prefix, read the pinned snapshot, and leave no worker process after releasing the capability. The idle-import regression confirms Lindera does not load in the parent process.

Candidate aggregation preserves per-entity occurrence counts, source IDs, known-name exclusions, and reading data; term variants preserve known-term precedence and choose the most frequent cluster representative.

The public actions read the module-namespaced synonym dictionary, allow a single term to be merged into an existing group, preserve unknown YAML fields, propose candidate-ignore changes, and require explicit external-feature consent. A consent change is not effective before the selected snapshot changes.

dataMappings: Canonical entity/manuscript files are read from one pinned snapshot; diagnostics and statistical profiles are derived; lint fixes are proposed through Core operations.

proofs.result: The public diagnostics action uses the real supervised Lindera tokenizer and source-derived diagnostics worker, returns snapshot and engine identity, computes sentiment from the packaged source lexicon, and stops the child after the final lease is released.

Public action tests cover consistency and continuity findings, scene/chapter/volume scoping, declared/contextual voice profiles including low-confidence attributions, learned voice fingerprints, stylometric profile and outlier results, and lint-fix proposal-only behavior.

dataMappings: Snapshot-derived scene/manuscript/character/location/item/faction/event/thread/lore passages are sentence-split and sent to the optional semantic.embedding capability; cached embeddings and neighbor results remain provider-owned derived state.
Corpus synonym candidates retain the source 24-neighbor limit, score bands, POS-matched span extraction, deterministic ranking, current-scene exclusion, and source=corpus attribution.

proofs.result: A public diagnostics.analyze action indexes passages from the selected snapshot through the optional capability, requests bounded nearest hits, applies source span/ranking rules, checks returned snapshot/model identity, and releases the provider lease. The consumer test uses a deterministic provider test double; P09 owns actual embedding-engine certification.

compositionLimits: This is module-level public-action evidence using the actual supervised Lindera CPU engine. It does not certify the composed HTTP/API, browser, MCP, full-profile, or Core approval/checkpoint/publish paths.

The corpus-neighbor consumer is wired to semantic.embedding but its focused consumer test uses a provider test double. P09 must verify the actual pinned embedding model and worker before composed corpus search is claimed.

Contradiction candidate/rebuild/dismissal behavior from R21 is owned by P09 semantic rather than this P06 diagnostics module. R29's hierarchical snapshot writing-statistics aggregation is Core-owned; this module owns richer per-text prose and sentiment metrics.

P12 still owns composed legacy-import registration and the delete/reclone round trip for diagnostics/NLP settings. The module migration producers and namespaced runtime reads are present, but this evidence does not claim that end-to-end migration proof.
